SELECT S.SCHEDULE_CODE , S.SCHEDULE_NAME , S.APPLY_FROM_DATE , S.APPLY_TO_DATE , TO_CHAR(S.LAST_EXECUTION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_EXECUTION_DATE , S.STATUS , CASE S.STATUS WHEN '0' THEN '대기' WHEN '1' THEN '수행중' WHEN '2' THEN '완료' WHEN '3' THEN '오류' ELSE S.STATUS END AS STATUS_NAME FROM INTERFACE_SCHEDULE S WHERE S.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code}
AND S.SCHEDULE_CODE ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%')
AND S.SCHEDULE_NAME ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY S.SCHEDULE_CODE

SELECT 'attribute' || LPAD(X.RN::VARCHAR, 2, '0') AS DATA_FIELD , COALESCE(NULLIF(X.COLUMN_NAME, ''), X.TARGET_COLUMN) AS HEADER_TEXT , X.TARGET_COLUMN , X.SOURCE_COLUMN FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY D.INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL_ID) AS RN , D.COLUMN_NAME , D.TARGET_COLUMN , D.SOURCE_COLUMN FROM INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL D WHERE D.IF_CODE = #{if_code} AND D.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND D.USING_YN = 'Y' ) X WHERE X.RN <= 50 ORDER BY X.RN
